_description: Central configuration for solver tuning. Edit values here to run experiments without changing source code.
_fallback_policy: If config.json is missing, invalid, or a specific key is absent, the code automatically falls back to built-in defaults in main.jl (load_project_config).
_override_policy: CLI arguments (for example --pop-size or --generations) override values defined in this file.

single_run._description: Default settings for single-instance runs via main.jl.

ga._description: Genetic algorithm behavior and local-search controls.

penalties._description: Penalty multipliers for soft-constraint guidance during search.

batch._description: Default settings used by run_all_tests.jl for train/test sweeps.
